name: EPIC 211630893

text.card: A red giant 6,211 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 2.16 solar masses and 15.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,923 K at its surface.
